invariants.rule_dual_sha_locking: No claim-bearing R3 experiment may execute or seal until both system_under_test_sha and parent_harness_sha are verified and prospectively frozen.
invariants.rule_chronological_freeze: All protocol, budget, and manifest freeze timestamps must strictly precede experimental execution timestamps.
invariants.rule_backend_truthfulness: Simulated backends must never be labeled or claimed as PostgreSQL instances; actual database executions must run against PostgreSQL 16.14 at localhost:5433.
